CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Spring-2021 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Spring-2021 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 669 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 2 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: September 2021 to November 2021). These surveys captured 5 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 7 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 745 cards across 48 sites, with 11.9% showing evidence of mouse activity (89 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 240 transects across 41 sites (survey period: September 2021 to November 2021), detecting active burrows in 7.5% of transects (total: 44 active burrows).
